home.q: For water softeners in Mount Brydges, how should I sequence well filtration for the water?

home.q: For drain cleaning in Mount Brydges, how should I account for a septic system?
home.a: If the drain line serves a septic system, identify the tank, cleanouts and route toward the field before selecting a cleaning approach. home.q: How should I trace buried feeds before digging before work in Mount Brydges?
home.a: If a buried line runs toward a barn, greenhouse or other outbuilding, sketch its route and mark known entry and exit points.
